description: This is a shell script (`.sh`) used for telemetry and diagnostic management tasks on a network device. It performs various functions such as cleanup, configuration generation, scheduled operations, and data collection for telemetry purposes within a device management system.

methods.name: dcaCleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of telemetry files and markers, including removing temporary data and resetting states.

methods.name: pidCleanup
methods.description: Removes the PID file used to prevent duplicate script instances.

methods.name: getEstbMac
methods.description: Retrieves the device's MAC address via different methods depending on device type.

methods.name: getErouterIpv4
methods.description: Fetches the IPv4 address of the erouter interface.

methods.name: getErouterIpv6
methods.description: Fetches the IPv6 address of the erouter interface.

methods.name: getSNMPUpdates
methods.description: Performs SNMP walk to retrieve specific metrics based on a MIB and returns the aggregated value.

methods.name: getControllerId
methods.description: Fetches various controller IDs via SNMP and returns them in JSON format.

methods.name: getRFStatus
methods.description: Gathers RF status metrics via SNMP.

methods.name: processJsonResponse
methods.description: Pre-processes a JSON response file by formatting it for further use.

methods.name: scheduleCron
methods.description: Configures system cron jobs for telemetry tasks based on configuration files.

methods.name: dropbearRecovery
methods.description: Ensures the dropbear SSH server is running, starting it if necessary.

methods.name: clearTelemetryConfig
methods.description: Removes telemetry configuration and marker files and resets directories to default states.

methods.name: generateTelemetryConfig
methods.description: Generates telemetry configuration files based on input JSON data.
